questions.text: What is the training objective that drives next-token prediction?
options: Maximize the distance between input and output embeddings
Given a sequence of tokens, predict the next token at each position
Classify each token as positive or negative
Reconstruct randomly masked tokens in a sentence
questions.explanation: GPT-style models are trained with causal language modeling: predict the next token given all previous tokens. This is different from BERT's masked language modeling.

questions.text: What is the "sliding window" technique in data loading?
options: A GUI element for scrolling through text
Training only on the last N tokens and discarding the rest
Moving a fixed-size window across the text with a stride to create overlapping input-target pairs
A type of attention mechanism
questions.explanation: The sliding window moves a fixed-length chunk across the tokenized text, stepping by a stride value. Each window position creates one input-target pair for training.

questions.text: If stride equals context length, what happens to training data?
options: No overlap between consecutive chunks — each token appears in exactly one training example
Maximum overlap — the model sees every token many times
The data loader skips every other token
Training becomes impossible due to data loss
questions.explanation: When stride = context_length, chunks don't overlap. This is efficient but means each token is only in one context. A smaller stride creates overlapping examples and more training data.

questions.text: Why do we shuffle training examples across batches?
options: To make the training data smaller
To reduce correlation between consecutive batches and improve generalization
To speed up the tokenization process
To avoid out-of-memory errors
questions.explanation: Shuffling breaks the sequential order of text chunks, preventing the model from learning spurious correlations from consecutive pieces of the same document.

questions.text: In an input-target pair with context length 4 and tokens [A, B, C, D, E], what is the target sequence?
options: [A, B, C, D]
[A, B, C, D, E]
[B, C, D, E]
questions.explanation: Input is [A, B, C, D] and target is [B, C, D, E] — each target token is the next token after the corresponding input position. The model learns to predict one step ahead at every position.

questions.text: Care este obiectivul de antrenare pentru predicția next-token?
options: Maximizarea distanței între embeddings de intrare și ieșire
Dat fiind o secvență de tokeni, prezice următorul token la fiecare poziție
Clasificarea fiecărui token ca pozitiv sau negativ
Reconstrucția tokenilor mascați aleatoriu
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Modelele GPT folosesc modelarea cauzală a limbajului: prezicerea următorului token dat fiind toate tokenele anterioare.

questions.text: Ce este tehnica „ferestrei glisante" în încărcarea datelor?
options: Un element GUI pentru derularea textului
Antrenarea doar pe ultimele N tokeni
Mutarea unei ferestre de dimensiune fixă peste text cu un pas pentru a crea perechi input-target suprapuse
Un tip de mecanism de atenție
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Fereastra glisantă mută un fragment de lungime fixă peste textul tokenizat, avansând cu un pas. Fiecare poziție creează o pereche input-target.

questions.text: Dacă pasul egalează lungimea contextului, ce se întâmplă cu datele de antrenare?
options: Fără suprapunere — fiecare token apare într-un singur exemplu de antrenare
Suprapunere maximă — modelul vede fiecare token de multe ori
Încărcătorul de date sare peste fiecare al doilea token
Antrenarea devine imposibilă
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Când pas = lungimea_contextului, fragmentele nu se suprapun. Aceasta este eficientă dar fiecare token e într-un singur context.

questions.text: De ce amestecăm exemplele de antrenare între loturi?
options: Pentru a face datele mai mici
Pentru a reduce corelația între loturi consecutive și a îmbunătăți generalizarea
Pentru a accelera tokenizarea
Pentru a evita erorile de memorie
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Amestecarea rupe ordinea secvențială, prevenind modelul să învețe corelații false din piese consecutive ale aceluiași document.

questions.text: Într-o pereche input-target cu lungimea contextului 4 și tokeni [A, B, C, D, E], care este secvența target?
options: [A, B, C, D]
[A, B, C, D, E]
[B, C, D, E]
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Input este [A, B, C, D] și target este [B, C, D, E] — fiecare token target este următorul token după poziția input corespunzătoare.

questions.text: Ποιος είναι ο στόχος εκπαίδευσης για πρόβλεψη επόμενου token;
options: Μεγιστοποίηση απόστασης μεταξύ embeddings εισόδου-εξόδου
Δεδομένης μιας ακολουθίας tokens, πρόβλεψη του επόμενου σε κάθε θέση
Ταξινόμηση κάθε token ως θετικό ή αρνητικό
Ανακατασκευή τυχαία μασκαρισμένων tokens
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Τα GPT χρησιμοποιούν αιτιακή μοντελοποίηση: πρόβλεψη επόμενου token βάσει όλων των προηγούμενων.

questions.text: Τι είναι η τεχνική «συρόμενου παραθύρου» στη φόρτωση δεδομένων;
options: Στοιχείο GUI για κύλιση κειμένου
Εκπαίδευση μόνο στα τελευταία N tokens
Μετακίνηση παραθύρου σταθερού μεγέθους πάνω στο κείμενο με βήμα για δημιουργία ζευγών input-target
Τύπος μηχανισμού attention
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Το συρόμενο παράθυρο μετακινεί τμήμα σταθερού μήκους πάνω στο tokenized κείμενο, δημιουργώντας ζεύγη εκπαίδευσης.

questions.text: Αν το βήμα ισούται με το μήκος πλαισίου, τι συμβαίνει;
options: Χωρίς επικάλυψη — κάθε token εμφανίζεται σε ένα παράδειγμα
Μέγιστη επικάλυψη — πολλές εμφανίσεις κάθε token
Ο φορτωτής παραλείπει κάθε δεύτερο token
Η εκπαίδευση γίνεται αδύνατη
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Όταν βήμα = μήκος_πλαισίου, τα τμήματα δεν επικαλύπτονται. Αποδοτικό αλλά κάθε token σε ένα πλαίσιο μόνο.

options: Για μικρότερα δεδομένα
Για μείωση συσχέτισης μεταξύ διαδοχικών παρτίδων και βελτίωση γενίκευσης
Για ταχύτερη tokenization
Για αποφυγή σφαλμάτων μνήμης
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Η ανακάτεμα σπάει τη διαδοχική σειρά, αποτρέποντας ψευδείς συσχετίσεις από συνεχόμενα κομμάτια.

questions.text: Σε ζεύγος input-target με μήκος 4 και tokens [A, B, C, D, E], ποια η ακολουθία target;
options: [A, B, C, D]
[A, B, C, D, E]
[B, C, D, E]
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Input [A, B, C, D], target [B, C, D, E]. Κάθε target token είναι το επόμενο μετά την αντίστοιχη θέση εισόδου.
